description: The AutoSEO content pipeline for a domain: topics waiting to be written, and the articles already generated or published, with the keyword or prompt that produced each one. Articles come newest first, 30 at a time: pass a previous call's `nextCursor` as `before` for older ones, and `status` for only the live, review, rejected or attention ones. Use it to see what is in flight before queueing more. Free, reads stored data. Requires a signed-in account.

before.description: A previous call's `nextCursor`, for the next page of older articles. Later pages carry the articles only.

status.description: Only these articles: live (published or sent to the site), review (waiting for approval), rejected, or attention (held by the publishing checks, or not delivered). Default all.

name: list_content_queue
